The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Waheed, reviewed & tested by by 
 eng. Hassan El-Sayed Abdel-Azez, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Mohamed Hassan 
 Zayed, approved by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of Sidi 
 Kirir Power Station, and 
 certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC engineering consultant 
 A and MPIS coordinator.
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any 
 maintenance procedure.

Introduction
This document outlines equipment inspection I1, to be preformed every 
six months bases as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Waheed, reviewed & tested by by 
 eng. Hassan El-Sayed Abdel-Azez, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Mohamed Hassan 
 Zayed, approved by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of Sidi 
 Kirir Power Station, and 
 certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC engineering consultant 
 A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any
